slides.headline: *venus* went into capricorn. romance got a calendar
slides.body: until march 1. read it as: the person who follows up is the person who's interested.

slides.headline: a soft-focus day. *venus* met the fog
slides.body: astrologers read venus square neptune as a day to want what you imagine, not what's there. check again in daylight.

slides.headline: the annular *eclipse* in aquarius drew its ring
slides.body: a new moon reset. if you started one honest thing this week, that was the move.

slides.headline: *venus* and mars got along, for once
slides.body: a trine reads as easy flow between wanting and doing. mercury also opposed mars today: easy to want, easy to snap. pick the first.
